steps.description: Trade Compliance screens the recipient against the Denied Party List before any export proceeds.

evidence.quote: the Trade Compliance team must screen the recipient against the Denied Party List (DPL)
No export may proceed until the DPL screen is completed

steps.description: If recipient is not on the DPL, Trade Compliance assesses whether an export license is required based on the ECCN and destination country.

evidence.quote: Trade Compliance assesses whether an export license is required based on the product's Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) and the destination country

steps.description: For sanctioned countries (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia), Legal and Trade Compliance jointly approve the transaction; no export proceeds without a valid export license.

evidence.quote: Legal and Trade Compliance must jointly approve the transaction, and no export may proceed without a valid export license

steps.description: For EAR99 items to non-sanctioned countries, no export license is required; the DPL screen already completed satisfies the pre-export requirement.

evidence.quote: Items classified as EAR99 destined for non-sanctioned countries do not require an export license, but the DPL screen must still be completed prior to export

steps.description: All export transaction records must be retained for a minimum of 5 years.

evidence.quote: All export transaction records must be retained for a minimum of 5 years
